Incumbent Democrat [[Howard Dean]] ran successfully for re-election to a fourth full term as [[Governor of Vermont]], defeating Republican candidate [[Ruth Dwyer (politician)|Ruth Dwyer]]. This is the last time to date that [[Franklin County, Vermont|Franklin County]] voted Democratic in a gubernatorial election. ==Democratic primary== ===Results=== {{Election box begin|title =
